'''Amniva Silvoi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He participated in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as part of the Imperial Blizzard Force, and was stationed at the entrance of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a rebel sharpshooter during the battle while the rebels were retreating.
